t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Be focussed, make sure you always hit the keys in time. But don't follow any particular pattern. Make use of the breaks and rest your eyes.

vb_textbox.text: The most important thing is just to focus, and respond quickly. Don't try looking for patterns in what might give more mushrooms, because there doesn't seem to be any, although you will probably look for them anyway! Just make sure that you hit S or K when you see the gnomes, within 1.5 seconds, and the Space bar when you see the basket in the forest, again within 1.5 seconds. You will get mushrooms the majority of the time if you make sure to hit the keys at the right time. Make use of the breaks to help regain focus!
